label: Projected population (mid-year)
where_to_find: Report of the Technical Group on Population Projections (NCP, 2020). Use the table of projected total population by state for 1 March / mid-year of each year. Values in the report are in thousands: multiply by 1,000.

label: Government e-transactions in the year
where_to_find: e-Taal dashboard > state-wise view. Select each year (Jan-Dec) and record total e-transactions for every state/UT.

label: Direct Benefit Transfer amount in the financial year
where_to_find: DBT Bharat > State/UT-wise DBT. Data are by financial year: record FY 2018-19 against year 2018, FY 2019-20 against 2019, and so on (note this in the report).

label: Wage payments generated within 15 days
where_to_find: MGNREGA MIS > Reports > payment timeliness (wage payments generated within 15 days), state-wise, by financial year (FY 2018-19 -> 2018). Enter NS for units where MGNREGS does not operate (e.g. fully urban UTs).

label: Women's share of person-days generated
where_to_find: MGNREGA MIS > Reports > employment/demographic report: women person-days as % of total person-days, state-wise, by financial year. Enter NS where MGNREGS does not operate.

label: PDS transactions Aadhaar-authenticated on ePoS
where_to_find: Annavitran portal > state-wise monthly ePoS transactions: Aadhaar-authenticated transactions / total transactions, averaged over Jan-Dec. Enter NS for UTs that replaced grain distribution with cash transfers.

label: NeSDA state portal assessment score
where_to_find: NeSDA reports (2019, 2021, 2023): state portal overall scores. Rescale to 0-1 if the report uses another range. Leave other years blank.

label: Internet subscribers per 100 population
where_to_find: TRAI Indian Telecom Services Performance Indicators, Oct-Dec quarter report of each year: service-area-wise internet subscribers per 100. Service areas cover several states; enter the area value for every state it covers (see config/trai_service_areas.csv) and mark it as a proxy.

label: Literacy rate, Census 2011 (constant over years)
where_to_find: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States > literacy rate table, Census 2011 column. Time-invariant: enter the same Census 2011 value for every year (it enters the models only through interactions).

label: Per-capita NSDP at constant prices
where_to_find: Handbook > Per Capita Net State Domestic Product (constant prices). FY 2018-19 -> 2018. Latest years may be missing for some states; leave blank.

label: Women's share of Jan Dhan accounts
where_to_find: Same report: female beneficiaries / total beneficiaries x 100 (compute if only counts are given).

label: Rural/semi-urban share of Jan Dhan accounts
where_to_find: Same report: rural/semi-urban branch beneficiaries / total x 100.
